0022600088.text: Both the Bulls and the Raptors open their 2026-27 seasons with this game, which takes place in Toronto. Chicago is without Nic Claxton, who is day-to-day with a hamstring injury, while Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram, who is out following Achilles surgery, and Nate Bittle, who is day-to-day with a foot injury. The Bulls lost the 2025-26 season series 0-3, including a 139-109 defeat in Chicago on March 18, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Chicago a 25% chance of winning.
